name: verifai
description: Verifai — local-only Angular + NestJS + PostgreSQL workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently -n be,fe -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run migration:run --if-present && npm --prefix backend run seed:admin --if-present
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint --if-present && npm --prefix frontend run lint --if-present
